title: On-Policy Transition Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates expert capabilities into a single student by matching teacher and student final-layer distributions on student-generated rollouts. We investigate whether depthwise prediction transitions, the changes in predictions between layers, can provide additional task-relevant supervision. Our diagnostic study finds that stronger teacher--student agreement in intermediate transitions is associated with higher answer correctness within questions, with correct responses exhibiting lower mean transition KL across all measured intermediate layer pairs. These observations motivate On-Policy Transition Distillation (OPTD), which augments final-layer distribution matching by aligning teacher and student layer-to-layer log-probability increments on student-generated rollouts. translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生模型生成的采样轨迹上匹配教师模型与学生模型的最终层分布，将专家能力整合到单个学生模型中。我们研究了深度方向上的预测过渡——即各层之间预测的变化——能否提供额外的与任务相关的监督信号。我们的诊断性研究发现，教师与学生在中间层过渡上的一致性越强，答案正确率越高，正确回答在所有测量的中间层对上均表现出更低的平均过渡KL散度。这些观察启发了在线策略过渡蒸馏（OPTD）的提出，该方法通过在学生生成的采样轨迹上对齐教师与学生的逐层对数概率增量，来增强最终层的分布匹配。在涵盖数学、编程和指令遵循任务的三个骨干模型和八个基准上的评估表明，OPTD 取得了……
tldr: 该论文发现教师与学生在中间层预测过渡上的一致性与答案正确率正相关，并提出在线策略过渡蒸馏（OPTD），通过在学生生成的轨迹上对齐教师与学生的逐层对数概率增量来增强传统最终层分布匹配，从而提升蒸馏效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that stronger teacher-student agreement in intermediate layer transitions correlates with higher answer correctness, and proposes On-Policy Transition Distillation (OPTD), which augments final-layer distribution matching by aligning layer-to-layer log-probability increments between teacher and student on student-generated rollouts to improve distillation performance.
